name: ColdState API
description: Deterministic, verifiable knowledge retrieval. Global knowledge base (48M entries, 35 domains) with fetch / cite / verify primitives, plus zero-knowledge custom indexes. Identical query + kb_snapshot ⇒ identical results. Also exposed as an MCP server at /mcp (Streamable HTTP, stateless).
